name: @halonicjs/adapter-fs-tauri
description: The TrustStore, RunStore, BlobStore, RecordStore, DefinitionStore and HostSettingsStore ports over the Studio shell's trust_*, run_*, blob_*, record_*, fs_* and host_settings_* commands, sharing the trust folder, the run, blob and record folders, the workspace files and the host settings with the CLI and one opened-folder list with git.
